title: Crispy Cumin Coated Chicken
subtitle: with pumpkin chunks, chickpea salsa & sultanas
description: Lush, crispy, cumin-coated chicken pieces sit alongside chunky pumpkin. A spicy chickpea salsa with sweet pops of golden sultanas and a zip of fried garlic elevates this wholesomely chic dish to a whole new level. Quick and easy, simple and tasty!

instructions.title: START
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the chicken pieces on half of a roasting tray, toss with the cumin and oil, and season. Place the pumpkin pieces on the half of the roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out evenly. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and starting to crisp.

instructions.title: CRISPY CHICKPEAS
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the drained chickpeas for 12-15 minutes until crispy and golden in colour. For the best result, only shift occasionally. If they start to pop out, use a lid to rein them in! In the final 1-2 minutes, add the grated garlic, chopped sultanas, and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly.

instructions.title: SPICY SALSA
instructions.text: Place the crispy chickpeas mixture in a bowl. Add the diced onion to taste, baby tomatoes, and ½ of the chopped coriander. Toss through sliced chilli, white wine vinegar, and seasoning – all to taste!

instructions.title: DELICIOUS DINNER
instructions.text: Plate up the pumpkin alongside the chicken and chickpea salsa. Garnish with the remaining coriander. Well done, Chef!

chef_tip: To check if your chicken is ready, pierce it with a knife. If it’s cooked through, the juices will run clear.
